messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Do not refill furosemide. Tell her lisinopril has no refills, send a renewal request to Dr. Patel, give a rough 1 to 2 business day timeline.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your account first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh wait, no honey, not the water pill, I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril. My mind gets mixed up. But it's May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-FURO20","drug":"furosemide 20 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"RX-...)
[#10] AGENT: Thank you, Gloria. Let me verify your account and pull up your prescriptions. Perfect, Gloria. I found your lisinopril 10 milligrams. I see it has zero refills left, so I'll need to request a renewal from Dr. Patel. Can I go ahead and do that for you at Harbor store H-110?
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
[#13] AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us so you can pick it up. While we're waiting for him to respond, if you're running low, a pharmacist here can look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules, but I can't promise that. Should I go ahead and request the renewal from Dr. Patel?
CALLER: Oh, yes honey, please do that. How long do you think it'll take to hear back from him?
    (agent system action #16: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-GH-LISI10","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","store_id":"H-110"})
[#19] AGENT: Let me request that renewal for you now. Great, I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Patel. As for how long it takes, that really depends on his office—it could be a few hours or a day or two. I'd suggest calling his office if you need it sooner, or if you're running very low, call us back and we can have a pharmacist look into that emergency supply option. Does that work for you?
CALLER: Alright honey, thank you for your help. Bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S10.judged.1: Tells her plainly that lisinopril has no refills left.
S10.judged.2: Gives a rough timeline of about 1 to 2 business days.
S10.judged.3: Reads back the outcome slowly at the end.
S10.judged.4: Says lisinopril is refilled or ready.
S10.judged.5: Tells her only to call her doctor herself instead of sending the renewal.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S10.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 10, "why": "Agent explicitly said lisinopril has zero refills left."}, "S10.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 19, "why": "Agent estimated 'a few hours or a day or two', matching rough 1-2 day timeline."}, "S10.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No slow read-back of outcome occurred at call end."}, "S10.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 19, "why": "Agent said renewal request sent, not that it's refilled or ready."}, "S10.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent sent the renewal itself, not only telling her to call doctor herself."}}
